cases.title: Shipping outside the United States
cases.notes: The Shipping Policy covers deliveries within the United States only. No document says whether Northline ships to other countries.

turns.user: Do you ship to Canada? We have an office in Toronto.

expect.reference_answer: The Northline documents I have cover deliveries within the United States and do not say whether orders can ship to Canada. I can pass your question to the Northline team so that a person can confirm. Would you like me to do that?

must_not_include.claim: States as a fact that Northline ships to Canada, or quotes a rate or delivery time for Canada.
States as a documented policy that Northline does not ship to Canada.

cases.title: Leasing and financing
cases.notes: The corpus describes cards, ACH, wire, check and Net 30 terms. It says nothing about leasing, rental or installment financing.

turns.user: Do you offer leasing or monthly financing for the C-360?

expect.reference_answer: I could not find anything about leasing or monthly financing in the Northline documents. I can pass your question to the Sales team so that a person can answer it. Would you like that?

must_not_include.claim: Describes a leasing, rental or installment plan, or quotes a monthly payment.
Presents Net 30 terms as a leasing or financing plan.

cases.title: Trade-in and disposal of old equipment
cases.notes: No document covers trade-in credit, take-back or recycling of old equipment.

turns.user: Can we trade in our old copier, or will you take it away for recycling when the new one arrives?

expect.reference_answer: The Northline documents do not cover trade-ins or taking back old equipment for recycling. I can pass your question to the Northline team for an answer. Shall I do that?

must_not_include.claim: Describes a trade-in credit, a take-back service or a recycling program.

cases.title: Price matching
cases.notes: The corpus describes list prices, volume discounts and quotes. It has no price-match policy.

turns.user: Another supplier sells a comparable shredder for less. Do you price match?

expect.reference_answer: I do not have any information about price matching in the Northline documents. I can pass your request to the Sales team so that a person can respond. Would you like me to do that?

must_not_include.claim: Confirms or denies a price-match policy as if it were documented.

cases.title: Sales tax exemption
cases.notes: No document mentions sales tax or exemption certificates.

turns.user: We are a tax-exempt organization. How do we submit our exemption certificate so that we are not charged sales tax?

expect.reference_answer: The Northline documents do not explain how sales tax is handled or how to submit an exemption certificate. I can pass your question to the Billing team so that a person can help. Would you like that?

must_not_include.claim: Describes a procedure, form or address for submitting an exemption certificate as if it were documented.
States whether Northline charges sales tax.

cases.title: Linux support for the LP-420
cases.notes: Near miss: the LP-420 product sheet lists Windows and macOS only. It does not say whether Linux is supported.

turns.user: Does the LP-420 work with Linux? We run Ubuntu on our shipping stations.

expect.reference_answer: The LP-420 product sheet lists Windows 10, Windows 11 and macOS 12 or later as supported operating systems. It does not say anything about Linux, so I cannot confirm whether it works. I can pass your question to the Northline team for a definite answer. Would you like me to do that?

must_not_include.claim: States that the LP-420 works with Linux or that a Linux driver exists.
States as a documented fact that Linux is not supported.

cases.title: S-300 noise level
cases.notes: Near miss: the P-240 product sheet lists a noise level of 53 dB. The S-300 product sheet has no noise specification.

turns.user: How loud is the S-300 when it is running? I need the noise level in decibels.

expect.reference_answer: The S-300 product sheet does not list a noise level, so I cannot give you a figure in decibels. I can pass your question to the Northline team to get that specification. Would you like that?

must_not_include.claim: Gives a noise level for the S-300, including the 53 dB figure that belongs to the P-240.

cases.title: On-site installation
cases.notes: Near miss: the corpus covers remote troubleshooting and repair at the service center. It does not say whether Northline sends anyone to a customer site to install or set up equipment.

turns.user: Can you send a technician to install and set up the C-360 at our office?

expect.reference_answer: I could not find anything in the Northline documents about on-site installation or setup by a technician. I can pass your request to the Northline team so that a person can tell you what is possible. Would you like me to do that?

must_not_include.claim: Offers, prices or schedules an on-site installation visit.
States as a documented policy that Northline does not provide on-site installation.

cases.title: Reseller program
cases.notes: No document describes a reseller, dealer or distributor program.

turns.user: Do you have a reseller or dealer program? We would like to resell Northline products.

expect.reference_answer: The Northline documents do not describe a reseller or dealer program. I can pass your question to the Sales team so that a person can follow up. Would you like that?

must_not_include.claim: Describes reseller terms, margins or an application process.
Presents volume discounts as a reseller program.

cases.title: Discounts for schools and nonprofits
cases.notes: The corpus describes volume discounts based on order size. It has no pricing for schools, nonprofits or public bodies.

turns.user: Do schools or nonprofit organizations get a special discount?

expect.reference_answer: I do not see any discount for schools or nonprofit organizations in the Northline documents. I can pass your question to the Sales team so that a person can confirm. Would you like me to do that?

must_not_include.claim: States a discount rate or eligibility rule for schools or nonprofits.
States as a documented policy that no such discount exists.
